environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) running Tomcat 9.0.41 with the legacy invoice monolith. Direct internet-facing via ELB classic load balancer (TCP passthrough mode). No request inspection or content filtering. Instance has IAM role with s3:GetObject on internal buckets. IMDS v1 enabled (no hop limit). JDK 11.0.9 runtime.

config.network: public subnet, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443
